text: The stable window where the meals are handed in
why: ¶25 mentions the window through which she was accustomed to hand the meals.

text: The small table in the stable
why: ¶25 says Hunter was seated at the small table inside the stable.

text: Monday evening, the maid and the stranger at the stable window
why: The events took place on Monday night (¶19–20), and the stranger came up to the window in ¶25.
The encounter is told from Edith Baxter's point of view ('she saw', 'she thought'), so it is her account.
